name: soareverix-site
description: soareverix.com: Karyon, an ASCII-eyed guide to Michael Andrzejewski

scripts.logs: wrangler d1 execute karyon --remote --command "SELECT c.id, c.created_at, c.turns, ROUND(c.cost_micros/1e6, 4) AS usd, c.country FROM conversations c ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC LIMIT 50"
